import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.InputMismatchException;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class EducationalRound86E {

	public static long mod = 998244353;
	public static int max = (int)4e5+10;
	public static long[] fact;
	public static long[] infact;
	public static long[] modInv = new long[max];
	public static long[] nCrPrecomp = new long[200000];
	public static long[] fastCache = new long[200000];
	public static long[] gcdArray = new long[200000];

	public static void preCompute() {
		fact = new long[max];
		infact = new long[max];
		for(int i = 0; i < max; i++) {
			modInv[i] = ModInverse(i, mod);
		}
		fact[0] = 1;
		for(int i = 1; i < max; i++) {
			fact[i] = fact[i-1] * (long)i;
			fact[i] %= mod;
		}
		infact[0] = 1;
		for(int i = 1; i < max; i++) {
			infact[i] = ModInverse(fact[i], mod);
		}
		for(int i = 0; i < 200000; i++) {
			nCrPrecomp[i] = ModPow(i, mod-2, mod) * nCr(i, i) % mod;
		}
		fastCache[0] = 1L;
		fastCache[1] = 1L;
		for(int i = 2; i < 200000; i++) {
			fastCache[i] = fast(fastCache[i - 1], i);
		}
		for(int i = 0; i < 200000; i++) {
			gcdArray[i] = gcd(fact[i], mod);
		}
	}

	public static long nCr(int n, int r) {
		if(r > n) return 0;
		if(r == 0) return 1;
		if(r == 1) return fact[n];
		int temp = n - r;
		long ans = fact[n];
		ans *= fast(fast(n - 1, n),mod-2,mod);
		ans %= mod;
		long invr = fact[r];
		invr *= fast(fast(r-1, r),mod-2,mod);
		invr %= mod;

		return (ans * invr % mod * nCrPrecomp[n-temp] % mod);
	}

	public static long fast(long a, long n, long mod) {
		long ans = 1L;
		while(n > 0) {
			if(n%2==1) {
				ans = ans * a % mod;
			}
			a = a * a % mod;
			n /= 2;
		}
		return ans;
	}

	public static long nPr(int n, int r) {
		return fact[n] * fast(fact[n-r],mod-2,mod) % mod;
	}

	public static void solve() {
		preCompute();
		int n = in.nextInt();
		long k = in.nextLong();
		if(k == 0) {
			out.println(fact[n]);
			return;
		}
		if(n <= k) {
			out.println(0);
			return;
		}
		long ans = nCr(n, (int)k);
		int cols = n - (int)k;
		long sum = 0;
		for(int i = 0; i <= cols; i ++) {
			long tempans = nCr(cols, i);
			tempans *= fast(cols - i, n % (mod - 1));
			tempans %= mod;
			if((i&1)==1) {
				sum -= tempans;
				if(sum < 0) sum += mod;
			}else {
				sum+=tempans;
				if(sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
			}
		}
		out.println(sum*(ans*2 % mod) % mod);
	}

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		in = new FastReader();
		out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
		preCompute();
		solve();
		out.close();
	}

	public static class Triplet {
		long gcd;
		long x;
		long y;

		Triplet(long gcd, long x, long y) {
			this.gcd = gcd;
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}
	}

	public static Triplet extendedEuclideanAlgo(long a, long b) {
		if (a == 0) {
			return new Triplet(b, 0, 1);
		}
		Triplet ans = extendedEuclideanAlgo(b % a, a);
		long x = ans.y - (b / a) * ans.x;
		long y = ans.x;
		return new Triplet(ans.gcd, x, y);
	}

	public static long ModInverse(long a, long m) {
		Triplet ans = extendedEuclideanAlgo(a, m);
		if (ans.gcd != 1) {
			return -1;
		} else {
			long result = (ans.x % m + m) % m;
			return result;
		}
	}

	public static long gcd(long a, long b) {
		return gcd(b, a % b);
	}

	public static long powmod(long a, long n, long m) {
		long p = n;
		if (p == 0) return 1;
		long x = powmod(a, p/2, m);
		x = x * x % m;
		x = ((p % 2 == 0) ? x : x * a) % m;
		return x;
	}

	public static long ModPow(long a, long p, long mod) {
		long ans;
		if (p == 0) {
			return 1;
		} else {
			ans = 1;
			long kofa = ModPow(a, p/2, mod);
			if((p%2==0)) {
				return kofa * kofa % mod;
			} else {
				return kofa * kofa % mod * a % mod;
			}
		}
	}

	public static FastReader in;
	public static PrintWriter out;

	public static class FastReader {
		private final InputStream stream;
		private final byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
		private int curChar;
		private int numChars;

		public FastReader() {
			this(System.in);
		}

		public FastReader(InputStream stream) {
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		int nextInt() {
			int c = read();
			while(isSpaceChar(c))
				c = read();
			int sgn = 1;
			if (c == '-') {
				sgn = -1;
				c = read();
			}
			int res = 0;
			do {
				if(c<'0'||c>'9')
					throw new InputMismatchException();
				res *= 10;
				res += c - '0';
				c = read();
			} while (!isSpaceChar(c));
			return res * sgn;
		}

		long nextLong() {
			int c = read();
			while(isSpaceChar(c))
				c = read();
			int sgn = 1;
			if (c == '-') {
				sgn = -1;
				c = read();
			}
			long res = 0;
			do {
				if(c<'0'||c>'9')
					throw new InputMismatchException();
				res *= 10;
				res += c - '0';
				c = read();
			} while (!isSpaceChar(c));
			return res * sgn;
		}

		String next() {
			int c = read();
			while (isSpaceChar(c))
				c = read();
			StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
			do {
				if(c<'a'||c>'z')
					throw new InputMismatchException();
				res.appendCodePoint(c);
				c = read();
			} while (!isSpaceChar(c));
			return res.toString();
		}

		public int read() {
			if (numChars == -1)
				throw new InputMismatchException();
			if (curChar >= numChars) {
				curChar = 0;
				try {
					numChars = stream.read(buf);
				} catch (IOException e) {
					throw new InputMismatchException();
				}
				if (numChars <= 0)
					return -1;
			}
			return buf[curChar++];
		}

		boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
			return c==' '||c=='\n'||c=='\r'||c=='\t'||c==-1;
		}

		String nextLine() {
			int c = read();
			while (isSpaceChar(c))
				c = read();
			StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
			do {
				res.appendCodePoint(c);
				c = read();
			} while (!isSpaceChar(c));
			return res.toString();
		}
	}
}
